# Repository guidance
Read the root `AGENTS.md` and `docs/CURRENT_STATE.md` before making changes.
Use `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` to find the right module and `docs/TESTING.md` for checks.
Preserve geometry and saved-layout compatibility unless the task explicitly changes
them. Report conflicts between live defaults, exports, and historical notes; do not
resolve them by guessing. Keep detailed rules in AGENTS.md rather than duplicating
them here. Run the relevant documented checks and report unverified work honestly.
